name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard matches the task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' — every ringing step owes a switch toggle on that step or later, and since the siren stops exactly on the toggle step, one toggle per ring period closes the response. The toggle is the consequent of an 'each time' condition, not an unconditional goal, so no Existence is needed and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, the agent must eventually toggle the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
